card.name: Past allergic reaction history wording
card.fires_on: Small linking words and verbs inside phrases about a patient's previous allergic or hypersensitivity reactions, such as 'has had', 'reactions after', or 'reaction to' a drug.

modes.label: Linking word after reaction
modes.description: A linking word right after a reaction noun, introducing the drug or trigger.
modes.example: allergic-type reactions<< after>> taking aspirin or other NSAIDs.

modes.label: Verb after patient has
modes.description: The verb after 'the patient has' or 'a patient who has' in a history-of-reaction check.
modes.example: to determine whether the patient has<< had>> previous immediate hypersensitivity reactions to cef

card.plain: It marks the little words in warnings about patients who have had allergic reactions to a drug before.
